response.original_title: The Moment Of Truth 2: Take a Stand
response.overview: The Moment of Truth 2, Take a Stand is the continuing epic and often hilarious road journey of five guys who buy a Chevodge (a Chevy camper with a Dodge backend) and head out in search of the most incredible extreme sports ever seen. During their adventure they encounter some of the best extremists in the world of BMX, Surfing, Snowboarding, Motorcross, Air Surfing, and Skating and a new superior form of martial arts. Along the journey the guys discover what they believe. You too will be challenged to make a decision to take a stand for what you believe. What will you do when you're faced with the Truth? Truth Soul Armor represents today's youth and believes they are sold short by a society that is content to offer superficial dreams in a shallow pool of lust, greed, and ego. We believe this generation has an appetite for deeper things, which give life meaning and purpose.
